ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0006 is decisive in Part VIII: it requires that no physiological measure determine governance standing, and CTD-0005 adds subsistence to the protected list. The shipped bright-line formulation, which names speak, vote, lead, receive subsistence, and hold equal political standing, is stronger than the baseline's and is kept. CTD-0076 requires Scale as the singular and ICONS only as the plural, which changed several restored sentences in the first Scale and dragon chapters. CTD-0030 forbids presenting the Cardinal Scale as existing. CTD-0036 requires the eighty-seven, one hundred and fifty, and five hundred figures to remain distinct with their nesting explained. CTD-0069 governs the use of cultural traditions, which bears on the dragon material. CTD-0081 forbids numerology as evidence and was read. CTD-0012 keeps the Currency of Presence, COHERENCE, and Bio-Consensus distinct.

findings.summary: The account of what an incoherent civilization rewards was removed.

evidence.baseline: In an incoherent civilization, the capacities that are rewarded are domination, speed, extraction, charisma, and the manipulation of attention. These are the capacities that win, and so these are the capacities people cultivate, and so the civilization becomes ever better at exactly the things that are destroying it.

findings.diagnosis: The three-step chain, rewarded then cultivated then amplified, is the mechanism the whole reframe depends on, and it is the same selection argument the extractive attractor chapter made about institutions, now applied to persons. Without it the proposal to shift the reward structure has no account of why reward structures matter.

findings.summary: The claim that this is coordination infrastructure rather than a moral program was reduced.

evidence.baseline: This is not a moral program. It is coordination infrastructure. ... The claim is not that presence is virtuous, though it may be. The claim is that presence is a load-bearing substrate of reliable collective intelligence.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.3 read onto the paired denials.
findings.diagnosis: The retention limb applies squarely: a moral program is exactly what a reader will take this for, and the denial is the chapter's defense against the charge. Though it may be is also the concession that keeps the denial honest. The shipped limits paragraph on attention, regulation, and trust is a real addition and is kept.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Two em dashes. Both were parenthetical appositives and both became comma pairs.

The shipped limits paragraph, that attention is not labor, regulation is not virtue, and trust is not a commodity, and the shipped warning that calling coherence a form of capital must not authorize accumulating power over others. Neither is in the baseline and both bound the restored claim.
The account of what an incoherent civilization rewards, the selection chain, the not a moral program denial, and the list of capacities the architecture would reward instead.

openQuestions: The section's measured word count exceeds the baseline's because the shipped limits paragraph is kept alongside the restored argument. Deliberate accumulation.

The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-04 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The section is the second in the volume where the shipped text supplies a limit the baseline lacks and the restoration keeps both. Where a paydown adds a bound rather than replacing a claim, the two compose.
